A conversation between several ElevenLabs voices in one audio file (Eleven v4 by default). The script input is one line per turn, "<voice name>: <text>", for example "Rachel: Hello there." then "Adam: Hi!". The speaker is everything before the first colon. Use names from the person's ElevenLabs voice library; they match ignoring case, and a voice ID works in place of a name. Before the paid call Nebula looks the names up in their voices (a free call). A name that matches no voice, or more than one, stops the run without generating, and the error lists the candidate voices with their IDs. Up to 10 different voices and 2,000 characters per run. Audio tags such as [whispering] go in the text.
A saved character's identity (reference views, frozen traits, seed) for cinematic and edit nodes. Set character to a character id; GET /api/characters lists them.
A saved Nebula moodboard as creative direction: its style brief, negative prompt, palette and representative images. Set moodboard to a board id; GET /api/moodboards lists the boards.
Black Forest Labs' fast open-weights FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B, distilled): text to image, or edit with up to 10 reference images. Runs on BFL or OpenRouter.
Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 image model: text to image, or edit and combine up to 10 reference images. Runs on BFL, fal.ai, Replicate or OpenRouter.
Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Video: text to video with sound, animate a start image, an end image or up to 10 keyframes, or continue a video clip. Runs on BFL, fal.ai, Replicate, OpenRouter or Krea.
Black Forest Labs' FLUX Video Edit [fast]: change a video clip with a text prompt; the edit keeps the clip's length. Runs on BFL, fal.ai or Krea.
Black Forest Labs' FLUX Video Upscale: upscale a video clip 1.5x to 3x, precise or creative, with an optional prompt. Runs on BFL, fal.ai, Replicate or Krea.
Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 family (FLUX.2 [pro], [max], [flex], [klein] 9B and [klein] 4B, plus fal's FLUX 2 Flash): text to image. Runs on BFL or fal.ai.
ElevenLabs voice ID (runs on your ElevenLabs key)

high reasoning without a reference image (fal.ai takes it on krea/v3/edit only)

Judge, classify or score text and images with one typed question: yes/no, pick one option, or rate on a scale. Returns the answer, its probability, confidence and a pass / fail / unsure verdict. Also a gate: whatever is connected to “Through” comes out of “On Pass” or “On Fail”, and the nodes on the other branch are skipped. TypeSafe Jev makes decisions only, no text generation. Image input is experimental.
Krea's own Krea 3 image model: text to image, or edit with up to 8 reference images. Runs on Krea (early access for beta workspaces) or fal.ai.
Levels, Low to High (one per line)

Pick the best of several candidate images against a brief, in one typed Choice. Returns the winning image itself, its index, every candidate's probability and how confident the pick is; low confidence means the candidates are close. TypeSafe Jev makes decisions only, no text generation. Image input is experimental.
